title: The Three Lives of Data
summary: The three states are not a taxonomy for its own sake. They are a diagnostic tool."Encrypt everything" is not a strategy. Knowing which state you are protecting, from whom, and with what key is.

title: Cloud vs On-Premise: Security, GDPR and Health Data
summary: Cloud and on-premise do not differ in how much risk exists. They differ in where the risk sits. The same logic applies to anonymisation and AI.

title: Smishing Alert: The elasgov.cc Fake Traffic Fine Scam
summary: The elasgov.cc campaign is a textbook example of smishing: it combines impersonation of authority, urgency, and technical evasion to steal money and data.

title: The Significance of the Data Factory: From Abstract Pattern to Salesforce Test Classes
summary: The data factory is more than a helper class. It is a design commitment — a promise that test data creation will be centralised, isolated, and readable.

title: Visit Job Execution: Consumer Goods Cloud vs. Field Service
summary: How Salesforce addresses field visit execution across Consumer Goods Cloud and Field Service, when to choose each, and whether a native Flow build is worth it.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Engagement vs. Account Engagement vs. Next
summary: The three Marketing Cloud platforms are not competitors. The question is never which cloud is better, but which execution model matches how our marketing actually works.
